meta.description: How to use the Adaptyv Bio Foundry API and Python SDK for protein experiment design, submission, and results retrieval. Use this skill whenever the user mentions Adaptyv, Foundry API, protein binding assays, protein screening experiments, BLI/SPR assays, thermostability assays, or wants to submit protein sequences for experimental characterization.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabrication of experimental data; clear documentation that experiments are submitted to real lab facility

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for API integration and experiment submission workflow

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established protein characterization methods (BLI, SPR, thermostability)

code_usability.detail: Complete working code examples with proper error handling and authentication patterns

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive API coverage including all experiment types, lifecycle states, and workflows; minor gaps in edge case documentation for failed experiments

reliability.note: Good error handling documentation with request_id tracking; webhook patterns for async workflows; missing explicit retry guidance for transient failures

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (241 lines), clear sections, efficient structure; could benefit from quick-reference table of contents

agent_usability.note: Excellent trigger description with multiple specific patterns; clear workflow examples; when-to-use implicit but strong; minor: no explicit 'When NOT to Use' section

human_usability.note: Excellent setup instructions, clear authentication guidance, multiple installation patterns, environment variable best practices

security.note: Perfect credential management: environment variables, .env file support, explicit warnings against hardcoding, token attenuation and revocation documented

maintainability.note: Good structure with version field (1.2) and license; clear references to external docs; missing changelog or version history

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with clear input/output contracts; good progressive disclosure; idempotency considerations present; dependency on beta SDK (not on PyPI) is minor risk

recommendations.title: Add explicit 'When NOT to Use' section
recommendations.problem: Skill lacks explicit boundary documentation for when Adaptyv is not appropriate
recommendations.root_cause: Trigger conditions are comprehensive but scope exclusions are implicit
recommendations.fix: Add 'When NOT to Use' section: Do not use for local-only sequence analysis, immediate results (21-day turnaround), or when computational prediction is sufficient without experimental validation

recommendations.title: Token attenuation examples missing
recommendations.problem: Token management concepts described but no working code examples provided
recommendations.root_cause: Security section mentions Biscuit-based attenuation but lacks implementation guidance
recommendations.fix: Add code example showing POST /tokens/attenuate request body structure with organization, resource type, and expiry scoping

recommendations.title: Sequence validation code example absent
recommendations.problem: Valid amino acid constraints documented but no validation logic shown
recommendations.root_cause: Documentation lists constraints but assumes SDK handles validation
recommendations.fix: Add example showing how to validate sequences before submission, either using SDK validation or simple regex pattern

recommendations.title: Missing changelog or version history
recommendations.problem: Version 1.2 specified but no information about changes from previous versions
recommendations.root_cause: Maintainability affected by lack of version history documentation
recommendations.fix: Add changelog section documenting changes between versions, or reference external changelog location
